annotations.title: Source check: are the documents still the same

description: Whether the documents behind an answer are still the bytes it was read from: give the evidence rows (or a canli-mcp receipt's sources) and each document is read again, past every cache, as the same, changed since, or unreachable. Only documents from the sources this server reads are fetched.

sources.description: The documents to check: evidence rows, or a receipt's sources.

url.description: The document's address, as the evidence or the receipt gives it.
